permutation_rule: Uniform label-blind derangements within G-present validation CVEs, shared across models/seeds; preserve target D and structured inputs.
bootstrap_rule: Paired stratified CVE resampling within each partition; same sampled CVEs for every model/seed; average paired metric differences across all seeds.
interpretation: Exploratory retrospective listing classification. Permutations test sensitivity to target-content matching, not a pure estimate of source-bias parameters or causal effects.
